description: Original STAC and vector receiving, native QGIS and QField operations, managed analyst workspace, edition review and complete project handover

commandDescriptions.stac-qgis: Receive original GIS sources, operate analyst and field workspaces, review editions and deliver complete native QGIS projects
commandDescriptions.stac-qgis-analyst: Open the original QGIS analyst workspace for sources, native maps, field collection, receiving and same-request recovery
commandDescriptions.stac-qgis-analyst-receiving: Continue an original saved QGIS project through the analyst browser, native map, Stop/reopen and complete independent receiving
